Exact crop from the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side; cover "official text as of April 27, 2013"), PDF page 35: the slip of •Odin Nesloor & •First Aid. It prints the text of version PC-E3, [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (the current text). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “95”). The release-sheet slip and the PC card image show only the Odin Nesloor art; the Master List slip shows the two-card split art (Odin Nesloor and First Aid).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]] (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
